android.desc:
The Official Magen David Adom App
Israel National Emergency Medical Services
 
 
The official Magen David Adom app in Israel provides immediate access to emergency services, first aid instructions, and life-saving courses and certifications.
 
Request an ambulance or contact the MDA emergency dispatch center via chat or video call at the touch of a button.
 
Share personal and family medical information to assist medical teams in real time.
 
Learn first aid principles, take online training courses, and earn certifications.
 
Donate blood, volunteer with MDA, and stay updated with medical news.
 
The app is user-friendly and easy to use, supports multiple languages, and includes customization options for your Personal Area, medical information, and family members.
 
Key Features:
 
Emergency call 101 – voice call, chat, or video.
 
Real-time sharing of medical details to save lives.
 
Digital first aid guides.
 
Blood donation, medical news, and updates.
